Things a wise man never
tells anyone

1. How much he earns

Numbers change how people
see you.

2. His goals before they're done

Talk kills momentum.

3. What he did for others

Good deeds lose value
when announced.

4. His weak spots

Only to the few who earned it.

5. How much he studies

Let the knowledge speak.
